profile.text: Eyjafjalla, Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. In recent years, she has participated in the production of multiple documentaries and written and published multiple books on volcanoes. She continues to receive treatment at Rhodes Island and undertakes a variety of activities, including Catastrophe research, as needed.
